headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 25, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Chicago Cubs edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates in a close game, securing a 3-2 win. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and an RBI. The Arizona Diamondbacks took down the Washington Nationals 3-2, securing a crucial win.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Josh Jung, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain. Spencer Arrighetti, Juan Soto, Shawn Armstrong, Tanner Banks, Rafael Flores Jr., Brad Keller, and Rafael Marchán have also been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for Future Considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Brewers 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Motor City**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Detroit Tigers, unable to overcome a strong outing from Tarik Skubal. Skubal led the Tigers to victory, tossing 7.1 innings with 12 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Pirates in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates in a close game, securing a 3-2 win. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Nationals in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks took down the Washington Nationals 3-2, securing a crucial win. Dylan Crews led the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Zack Littell pitched 5 strong innings for the Diamondbacks.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Key contributors for the Royals included Carter Jensen, Salvador Perez, and Vinnie Pasquantino, while the Tigers' Riley Greene and Hao-Yu Lee stood out in the loss.

top_news.title: **Jung Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers third baseman Josh Jung has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026. Jung's injury will keep him sidelined for the time being.

top_news.title: **Royals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a trade involving a player, but the player's identity has not been disclosed.
